quietArea.role: always-available rest region, no cue, no gate

scene.contactRule: first body-centre entry within contactRadius of a landmark centre during a trial
scene.layoutChangesOnlyAt: declared trial boundaries; never resets neural state or teleports the body

fixedReadout.yawConvention: right minus left, radians per second

variants.targetCounterbalance: seed parity: even seed index targets ring, odd targets bar

unresolvedReasons.causalMotorReadout: Recomputed first-hop signed drive for the already-recorded left-half onset volley. A first threshold crossing from rest needs 1000 net positive contacts at the fixed contact gain 0.001. This reproduces the recorded 0/8 negative campaign outcome from the source arrays and is independent of the onset amplitude, which only sets how many input ports fire, not the sign of what they deliver.
unresolvedReasons.compartmentMatchedEdges: Male CNS instance strings identify each MBON lobe/compartment label, but Kenyon cells carry only a lobe-level subtype and the pinned weights table has no per-synapse neuropil column, so no individual KC->MBON edge can be assigned to a compartment. BANC annotations carry no mushroom-body compartment field at all. Lobe consistency is the strongest relation derivable here and is coarser than the compartment specificity the protocol requires.

disclosure: Preregistered engineering configuration over measured anatomy. Not a biological calibration, a learning claim or a validated body loop.
